# MailMyPDF

> Upload a PDF or write a letter, and we print and mail it as a physical letter — no printer, no envelope, no post office trip.

MailMyPDF is a paid online service for sending PDF documents and letters through the U.S. postal system. Guest checkout is available — no account required. U.S. domestic mail only.

## Mailing options

- Standard Mail (3–7 business days): Starting at $4.99
- Certified Mail (delivery tracking + confirmation): +$9.95
- Registered Mail (secure handling + tracking): +$27.50
- Color printing: +$0.15 per page
- Scheduled/future letters
- Bulk mailing

## Additional features

- 20+ letter templates (legal, personal, business, official)
- AI-assisted dispute letter workflow
- MailMyPDF Pro subscription: $9.99/month, includes 5 free standard letters
- Order tracking and proof of mailing records
- Address verification
